name: Синхронизация цен

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: 'Режим'
        required: true
        default: 'both'
        type: choice
        options:
          - both
          - stock
          - prices

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Установка Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      
      - name: Установка пакетов
        run: pip install -r src/requirements.txt
      
      - name: Запуск синхронизации
        run: python -m src --mode ${{ github.event.inputs.mode || 'both' }}
        env:
          FTP_HOST: ${{ secrets.FTP_HOST }}
          FTP_USER: ${{ secrets.FTP_USER }}
          FTP_PASS: ${{ secrets.FTP_PASS }}
          FTP_FOLDER: ${{ secrets.FTP_FOLDER }}
          FTP_PRICE_FOLDER: ${{ secrets.FTP_PRICE_FOLDER || 'prices/' }}
          YM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YM_API_KEY }}
          YM_CAMPAIGN_ID: ${{ secrets.YM_CAMPAIGN_ID }}
          YM_WAREHOUSE_ID: ${{ secrets.YM_WAREHOUSE_ID }}
          YM_BUSINESS_ID: ${{ secrets.YM_BUSINESS_ID }}
      
      - name: Сохранение результатов
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: результаты
          path: src/data/**/*.json
          retention-days: 7
